text: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants should be healthy and well-behaved without criminal record, and be willing to abide by the laws of the Chinese government and the rules and regulations of the college, and respect the Chinese customs and habits. 2. Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passports, and comply with the Notice on Regulating the Acceptance of International Students by Chinese Higher Education Institutions (Jiaowai Han [2020] No. 12) and other relevant regulations of the Ministry of Education. 3. Applicants should be aged 18-35, with a high school diploma or above. The applicants will be selected based on their highest academic achievements.
